name: How do native plants contribute to green building?

mainEntity.name: How do native plants contribute to green building?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drought-tolerant native landscaping cuts irrigation 50-75%, supports biodiversity, reduces maintenance/chemicals, and preserves local hydrology versus turf grass.
